card.name: Linking words before onset or risk terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to" or "of" right after "time", "incidence" or "risks" in clinical result sentences. Also fires on the start of an author name or digit in citation lists.

modes.label: Time to event
modes.description: The word "to" or "first" after "median time" before an onset or progression event.
modes.example: The median time<< to>> onset of hyperglycemia was

modes.label: Incidence or risk of
modes.description: The word "of" after "incidence" or "risks" before an adverse event.
modes.example: the incidence<< of>> bone fracture in females was 5.

modes.label: Citation names
modes.description: First names or title words inside reference lists.
